program_narrative: Program RPTPOS00 is a batch program that produces the daily position report. It opens POSITION-MASTER and TRANSACTION-HISTORY for input and REPORT-FILE for output, writes three header lines (a line of asterisks, the title 'DAILY POSITION REPORT' and the system date), and then reads POSITION-MASTER sequentially until end of file. For each position record it moves the portfolio ID, description, quantity and current value into a detail line, computes the percentage change between current and previous value, and writes the detail line. It then performs the transaction-activity and summary steps (2210-READ-TRANSACTIONS, 2220-SUMMARIZE-ACTIVITY, 2310-WRITE-TOTALS, 2320-WRITE-EXCEPTIONS, 2330-WRITE-METRICS), but none of those paragraphs exists in the source, so that part of the logic is unknown; TRANSACTION-HISTORY is opened and closed but never read in the traceable code. Finally it closes all three files and returns. Error conditions handled: a failed OPEN of any file displays an error message, sets return code 12 and ends the program; end of file on POSITION-MASTER ends the detail loop. Several data names used by the logic (END-OF-POSITIONS, WS-ERROR-MESSAGE, POS-DESCRIPTION, POS-CURRENT-VALUE, POS-PREVIOUS-VALUE) are not declared in the program or its copybooks.
